_comment: Candidate shops for scripts/discover.mjs to probe.
SECONDHAND ONLY. A retail boutique's full price for a current-season piece
is not a comp for a fifteen-year-old archive jacket — it is a ceiling nobody
pays on the resale market, and pooled into a comp set it drags every resale
estimate upward, inventing margin that is not there. Retail sites are
therefore not listed here, and anything added as kind:retail is excluded
What belongs here: archive dealers, Japanese secondhand chains, and
one-person resellers — the places a piece can actually be bought under its
These are CANDIDATES, not a verified list. Discovery probes each and adds
only those answering with a public feed robots.txt allows, carrying
something from the roster. A dead or moved domain costs one request and one
Currency is read from the shop itself and never inferred from the country.

Every entry here is a GUESS at a domain until discovery probes it. Nothing is verified by being in this file: a name that has moved, closed or never existed costs one request and prints one skip line saying why. Adding a plausible candidate is therefore cheap and safe; asserting one works is not.
Add one you know of:  npm run add-source -- --domain shop.example --currency EUR
